# Merlay 0.6.7

- Merlay checks canvas edits with the active renderer before saving them or adding them to undo history. Rejected edits keep the original source and show a notice.
- Rapid visual edits are checked in order. VS Code also guards against delayed writes after source changes or diagram switches.
- Drag-to-connect keeps the relevant nodes in view at the current zoom and briefly highlights the new connection.

Named flowchart edges still require text editing. The syntax drawer saves manual edits as you type. See the [known issues and workarounds](https://github.com/dev-hashemi/merlay/blob/0.6.7/docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md).

Install through Obsidian Community plugins or [Open VSX](https://open-vsx.org/extension/dev-hashemi/merlay). You can also install the attached VSIX in VS Code.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/dev-hashemi/merlay/compare/0.6.5...0.6.7)
